---
title: "Set up"
---

## Files

```sh
git clone https://github.com/corne00/dynamic-gxe-workshop.git
cd dynamic-gxe-workshop
```

`R/functions.R` contains all functions used in the workshop (base R). `data/` contains the Narrabri weather, the biomass trajectories and the APSIM cultivar parameters. `scripts/parity_check.R` runs the complete pipeline.

## Packages

R 4.1 or later. The modelling code uses base R only. The figures use `ggplot2`:

```r
install.packages("ggplot2")
```

## Test run

```r
source("R/functions.R")

wx   <- read.csv("data/narrabri_weather.csv")
traj <- read.csv("data/narrabri_biomass.csv.gz")

drv   <- make_drivers(wx)
Theta <- make_library(drv)
tr    <- make_trajectories(traj, drv)
gram  <- gram_stats(Theta, tr)

cv <- cv_blocked(Theta, tr, gram, fit_ssr, k = 12)
round(evaluate(cv$pred, tr), 3)
```

The expected output is a trajectory RMSE of about 0.52 t/ha. The research implementation in Python gives 0.520, 0.688 and 0.749 for the trajectory, day-113 and maturity RMSE; this code gives 0.521, 0.689 and 0.747.
